node.title: Re^2: Go to perl::critic (goto considered awesome)
node.author: Anonymous Monk
node.doctext:
A C is considered a bad practice by a number of people, as it can lead to hard-to-understand and brittle spaghetti code.

Who cares what management thinks? Perl's goto LABEL is an awesome tool when one wants loop-like flow control outside of loops. It's the easy way to implement interactive shell scripts: INPUT: print 'number> '; chomp(my $input = ); if ($input and $input =~ /[0-9]+/) { print $input, "\n" } else { goto INPUT }
